propositions: config.py is 869 LOC, exceeding the 800-LOC module-size soft cap and grandfathered in the allowlist and ceilings files.
Extract the raw-input resolution layer (filesystem config discovery, TOML parsing with mtime-keyed cache, and REBAR_* env/legacy-alias override collection) into a new leaf module _config_sources.py.
The new leaf imports only stdlib, _config_schema, and _deprecations, with no back-edge import of rebar.config.
config.py re-exports the full moved set so rebar.config.<name> access and imports keep resolving unchanged for ~90 importers.
_TOML_CACHE shared-object identity and the monkeypatch seam via bare re-exported names must be preserved.
The stale config.py remedy row in docs/architecture.md is superseded and should be deleted; config.py must be removed from allowlist and ceilings files.
